motivation_architecture.identity_frame: You're becoming a Claude Agent SDK architect — someone who doesn't just use the SDK but understands its design philosophy, evaluates its tradeoffs, and builds systems that evolve with it.
process_goals: Build or extend one working agent component each session
Write at least one test for every new agent feature
Document one architectural decision or tradeoff per day
Review 5 Anki cards before each session
Check the SDK changelog once per week and evaluate one change

metadata.notes: Comprehensive intensive learning plan for Claude Agent SDK mastery. Progresses from core primitives through multi-agent orchestration, observability, production architecture, and synthesis. Designed for expert-level learner with strong Python and database expertise. Includes plateau protocols, competence markers, and detailed assessment strategy.

curriculum.philosophy: Translate Claude Code operational knowledge to SDK programmatic control through a structured progression: primitives → orchestration → observability → production → synthesis

task_classes.name: SDK Primitives Sprint
task_classes.description: Translating Claude Code operational knowledge to SDK programmatic control
task_classes.mastery_gate: Can build a complete SDK agent with custom tools, streaming, cost limits, and programmatic tool calling. Must demonstrate understanding of message types and when each appears.
task_classes.productive_failure_point: vertex-sdk-agent-loop — Give them a complex task and ask them to build the agent loop manually before showing query(). Surface the naive theory that 'I need to manage the loop myself like in LangChain' vs the SDK's autonomous loop.

tasks.title: Worked Example: Complete Agent with Postgres via SDK MCP
tasks.description: Walk through a complete agent that queries Postgres via SDK MCP with streaming and cost limits
tasks.deliverable: Annotated agent code with explanation of query() mechanics, message types, and tool binding

tasks.title: Completion Task: Add Streaming & Cost Controls
tasks.description: Given a partial agent, add streaming, cost limits, and a second custom tool
tasks.deliverable: Working agent with 2 custom tools, streaming enabled, and cost guardrails

tasks.title: Guided: Tool Search Across 10+ MCP Tools
tasks.description: Build an agent from scratch with tool search for 10+ MCP tools
tasks.deliverable: Agent that discovers and uses appropriate tools via tool search API

tasks.title: Conventional: Programmatic Tool Calling for AGE Queries
tasks.description: Implement programmatic tool calling to batch-query AGE graph traversals
tasks.deliverable: Agent performing structured batch queries with programmatic tool selection

tasks.title: Independent: Multi-Tool Postgres/pgvector/AGE Agent
tasks.description: Build a multi-tool agent connecting Postgres, pgvector similarity search, and AGE graph queries
tasks.deliverable: Complete working agent demonstrating all TC1 vertices with documented architectural decisions

task_classes.name: Control & Multi-Agent
task_classes.description: Hooks, permissions, subagents, orchestration, and team dynamics
task_classes.mastery_gate: Can architect a multi-agent system with appropriate isolation, permission models, hook-based control, and structured handoffs. Can explain when to use subagents vs agent teams.
task_classes.productive_failure_point: vertex-sdk-orchestration — Have them build a complex multi-agent workflow without proper handoffs/observability, let it fail, then reconstruct with proper patterns.

tasks.title: Worked Example: Multi-Agent Orchestrator with Hooks
tasks.description: Multi-agent orchestrator with Opus lead + Sonnet workers, hooks for logging and monitoring
tasks.deliverable: Fully instrumented multi-agent system with hook-based observability

tasks.title: Completion: Add Permissions & Error Recovery
tasks.description: Add permission layers and error recovery to an existing orchestrator
tasks.deliverable: Multi-agent system with permission boundaries and recovery patterns

tasks.title: Guided: Subagent Pipeline with Session Persistence
tasks.description: Build subagent pipeline with structured JSON handoffs and session persistence
tasks.deliverable: Subagent system with resumable sessions and structured data flow

tasks.title: Productive Failure: Debug Multi-Agent Without Observability
tasks.description: Design a multi-agent system without hooks/observability, then debug a failure
tasks.deliverable: Reconstructed system with proper hook-based instrumentation and lessons learned document

tasks.title: Conventional: Agent Team Parallel Analysis
tasks.description: Build an agent team that coordinates parallel database analysis across AGE subgraphs
tasks.deliverable: Working agent team with parallel execution and result synthesis

tasks.title: Independent: Full Orchestrator with Security & Memory
tasks.description: Full orchestrator with hooks-based security, permission layering, error recovery, memory tool, and session fork/resume
tasks.deliverable: Production-grade multi-agent orchestrator with all TC2 features

task_classes.name: Observability & Testing
task_classes.description: The biggest gap cluster — Tracing, testing frameworks, production ops, and metrics
task_classes.mastery_gate: Can instrument agents with OTel, configure an observability platform, write unit/integration/eval tests, and design monitoring for production.

tasks.title: Worked Example: OTel Tracing & Langfuse Integration
tasks.description: Instrument an existing agent with OTel tracing, view spans in Langfuse
tasks.deliverable: Agent with full OTel instrumentation streaming to Langfuse

tasks.title: Worked Example: Testing Framework with promptfoo
tasks.description: Write unit tests for tool calls, integration tests for agent flows using promptfoo
tasks.deliverable: Complete test suite with unit, integration, and eval tests

tasks.title: Completion: Add Tracing to Multi-Agent Orchestrator
tasks.description: Add tracing to the multi-agent orchestrator from TC2, configure Arize monitoring
tasks.deliverable: Instrumented orchestrator with multi-platform monitoring

tasks.title: Guided: Comprehensive Test Suite with Scorers
tasks.description: Design a test suite for a production agent: unit, integration, eval, with custom scorers
tasks.deliverable: Multi-layer test framework with custom evaluation metrics

tasks.title: Productive Failure: Deploy Without Monitoring
tasks.description: Deploy an agent to staging without monitoring, encounter a subtle failure, then add observability
tasks.deliverable: Debugging analysis and retrofit observability implementation

tasks.title: Conventional: Full Observability Pipeline
tasks.description: Build a full observability pipeline: OTel → Langfuse, custom metrics, anomaly alerts
tasks.deliverable: Integrated observability system with alerting

tasks.title: Independent: Observability Framework for Portfolio Project
tasks.description: Comprehensive test + observability framework for the portfolio project agent
tasks.deliverable: Production-ready observability and testing infrastructure

task_classes.name: Production Architecture
task_classes.description: Secure deployment, long-running patterns, architecture design, and evolution tracking
task_classes.mastery_gate: Can design a production deployment architecture, implement long-running patterns, and maintain a systematic SDK evolution tracking process.

tasks.title: Worked Example: Docker-Hardened Agent Deployment
tasks.description: Docker-hardened agent deployment with credential proxy and network isolation
tasks.deliverable: Secure Docker configuration with credential management patterns

tasks.title: Completion: Multi-Provider & Sandbox Runtime
tasks.description: Add sandbox-runtime and gVisor to an existing deployment, configure multi-provider fallback
tasks.deliverable: Deployment with sandbox isolation and provider failover

tasks.title: Guided: Long-Running Agent Architecture
tasks.description: Design a long-running agent with initializer+worker split, progress.txt, and session rituals
tasks.deliverable: Resilient long-running architecture with state management

tasks.title: Conventional: SDK Changelog Radar System
tasks.description: Build the 'SDK changelog radar' — automated tracking workflow for SDK releases
tasks.deliverable: Automated system tracking SDK changes and impact assessment

tasks.title: Independent: Production Architecture for Portfolio
tasks.description: Full production architecture for a portfolio project: secure deployment + long-running patterns + evolution tracking + architecture documentation
tasks.deliverable: Complete production-ready architecture with documentation

task_classes.name: Integration & Synthesis
task_classes.description: Full integration with portfolio project and synthesis of all knowledge
task_classes.mastery_gate: Can architect, build, test, deploy, and explain a complete agent system. Can articulate tradeoffs to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

tasks.title: Guided: API Layer Design
tasks.description: Design and implement an API layer wrapping agent functionality for a portfolio project
tasks.deliverable: REST/GraphQL API exposing agent capabilities with proper abstraction

tasks.title: Independent: End-to-End Portfolio Integration
tasks.description: End-to-end portfolio project integration — full agent system with Postgres/AGE/pgvector, observability, testing, secure deployment, and documentation
tasks.deliverable: Fully integrated, tested, observable, deployed agent system

tasks.title: Synthesis: Architecture Review & Defense
tasks.description: Present the system design, explain tradeoffs, defend architectural decisions
tasks.deliverable: Architecture review document and presentation
